theorem actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell_unique {m : ℕ}

    (hk : t ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m k) : j = k := by
  have hp : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
  have hr : 0 ≤ thirdPrefixRho := by norm_num [thirdPrefixRho]
  funext i
  apply Fin.ext
  by_contra hi
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hi with h | h
  · have hsep : actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi m j i ≤ actualExtendedThirdDyadicLo m k i := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hp
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hr
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt h
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hsep) ((hk.1 i (mem_univ _)).1.trans_lt (hj.1 i (mem_univ _)).2)
  · have hsep : actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi m k i ≤ actualExtendedThirdDyadicLo m j i := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hp
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hr
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt h
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hsep) ((hj.1 i (mem_univ _)).1.trans_lt (hk.1 i (mem_univ _)).2)

  have hargs : (actualExtendedThirdFiniteLevel e m t - t 0 - t 1 - t 2) / t 2 ≤

    (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hz).mpr (by linarith)
  have hd := monotone_actualExtendedThirdLowerFactor hargs
  unfold actualExtendedThirdFiniteKernel actualExtendedThirdCapKernel
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sub_nonneg.mpr hd))
    (le_of_lt (mul_pos (mul_pos (hz.trans_le (hzy.trans hyx)) (hz.trans_le hzy))
      (sq_pos_of_pos hz)))

selected_declarations.source_definition:
theorem actualExtendedThirdFiniteKernel_eq_sum_cells (e : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    actualExtendedThirdFiniteKernel e m t =
      ∑ j ∈ actualExtendedThirdRetainedCells e m, actualExtendedThirdRetainedCellKernel e m j t := by
  by_cases hcell : ∃ j ∈ actualExtendedThirdRetainedCells e m,
      t ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, ht⟩ := hcell
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj]
    · rw [actualExtendedThirdRetainedCellKernel_eq_indicator hj, indicator_of_mem ht]
    · intro k _hk hkj
      have hnot : t ∉ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m k := by
        intro htk
        exact hkj (actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell_unique htk ht)
      simp only [actualExtendedThirdRetainedCellKernel, indicator_of_notMem hnot]
  · have hout : ∀ j ∈ actualExtendedThirdRetainedCells e m,
        t ∉ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j := by
      intro j hj ht
      exact hcell ⟨j, hj, ht⟩
    have hzero : actualExtendedThirdFiniteKernel e m t = 0 := by
      rw [actualExtendedThirdFiniteKernel, actualExtendedThirdFiniteLevel_outside hout]
      simp only [actualExtendedThirdCapKernel, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_div]
    rw [hzero]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    simp only [actualExtendedThirdRetainedCellKernel, indicator_of_notMem (hout j hj)]
